title: Mail AI assistant
description: Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs. Configuration stays on this device and keys are stored in the system credential store. The single-email panel never analyzes automatically; background batches require separate consent.
deepseekHint: First-time setup defaults to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (API model: deepseek-flash) and requires your own API key. Saved configurations are never replaced automatically. The assistant disables thinking and requests JSON output. Connection tests and analysis may consume provider credits. The Bilibili translation toolbar remains separate.
endpointHint: Use the provider's API base URL (usually ending in /v1), not /chat/completions. Cloud services require HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for loopback addresses.
keyStored: Key saved. Leave blank to keep it; changing the service address will not carry the old key over
keyEmpty: No key saved. Leave blank if the service does not require authentication
privacy: Allow sending the subject and body of emails I manually select to: {{endpoint}}. Sensitive information within the body is also sent. Attachments and mailbox login credentials are not uploaded.
privacyHint: Review the provider's data policy first. Cancellation cannot recall text already sent. Changing the address requires consent again.
testHint: Sends only fixed synthetic text, never real email. Save changes before testing.
tested: Synthetic connection and structured response checks passed. Real email quality has not been verified.
configure: Open Settings → AI settings, enter a service URL and model, and grant email-sharing consent.
selectMail: Select and fully load an email. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
noTasks: No explicit action items were extracted.
machine: AI may omit or misunderstand information. Check the original. It cannot execute email instructions, modify emails, or send mail automatically.
cacheWarning: The result was generated but could not be cached locally.
clearHint: Deletes local AI/translation caches only, not emails, attachments, keys, tasks, or their excerpts. Sharing consent is unchanged.
cleared: Local AI and translation caches cleared.
cooldown: The service is rate limiting requests. Wait about {{seconds}} seconds, then retry manually.
intent: How would you like to reply?
intentHint: Provide only the necessary intent, without additional sensitive information.
adoptHint: Only fills the body. It does not set recipients or send mail. Review and enter recipients yourself.
existingDraft: Unsent content already exists and cannot be overwritten. Handle the existing composition first.
noSender: No sending account is connected. Connect an account first; the result remains readable.
adopted: Added to the composer. Review before sending manually.
AI_INVALID_INPUT: Invalid URL, model, or request parameters. Check your input.
AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: No AI service is configured. Save a service URL and model first.
AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Email sharing with this AI service is not authorized. Confirm consent in settings.
AI_BUSY: Another AI task is still running. Try again shortly.
AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is unavailable. Check the URL, model, and key.
AI_INVALID_RESPONSE: The model result was incomplete, invalid, or cited text outside the source. It was not used.
AI_RATE_LIMITED: The AI service is rate limiting requests. Retry manually later.
AI_STORAGE_FAILED: Unable to read or save local configuration, credentials, or cache. Check the system credential store and data directory, then retry.
AI_BODY_NOT_READY: The email body is not fully cached. Load it first.
AI_TOO_LARGE: The email exceeds AI limits (4 KiB subject, 32 KiB body). Nothing was truncated or uploaded.
AI_TIMEOUT: The AI request timed out. Retry manually later.
